name: QueryExecute
description: Executes a SQL query, returns the result.
syntax: QueryExecute( string sql, [any params], [struct options], [string name] )

params.name: params
params.description:
An array or structure containing parameter values.

When passing an array, use `?` as place holders and pass them in the order they are referenced in the SQL.

When passing a struct, use `:keyName`, where `keyName` is the name of the key in the structure corresponding to the parameter.

The array or structure can be a structure with keys that match the names of the [[tag-queryparam]] names: 

- maxlength
- list
- scale
- separator
- null
- cfsqltype|sqltype|type
-  value

params.name: options
params.description:
A struct containing the query options 

All the [[tag-query]] tag attributes are supported, except the `name` attribute.

params.name: name
params.description: name of the query produced, visible in dumps or debugging output.
